I can deal with them stopping the putrefaction and decay, but creating life seems too much.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Also, these microbes are apparently anentropic and can convert things into different elements.

That's why it's an SCP. You also forgot to mention that they're apparently sentient or are being controlled by a sentient entity (the two dead people?).

the only part of this that is even remotely an SCP is the microbes. Other than that, it's boring and dull

The microbes are most of the SCP. Only the first two paragraphs (out of eight) are spent describing the conditions in the house. I personally like the detail; it makes me wonder why the microbes decided to concentrate on those specific features of the house/crime scene.

In other news,

the bottom right leg

What exactly does that mean?

EDIT: While I'm here, it's my theory that the two dead people are manifesting their will as microorganisms, and they replicate these qualities of the house to draw our attention to them, because they're clues to the murder.
